Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Interface NewsArticleRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor<NewsArticleEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<NewsArticleEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<NewsArticleEntity,String>
public interface NewsArticleRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<NewsArticleEntity,String>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaSpecificationExecutor<NewsArticleEntity>
Spring Data JPA repository for NewsArticleEntity.

The existsByUrl method is the deduplication gate used by ArticleStorageAdapter before every insert — duplicate URLs are silently skipped per the ArticleStoragePort contract.

The findByTopic method backs the DB-based implementation of ArticleIngestionPort.fetchArticles(java.lang.String, int), replacing the stub that previously returned an empty list.
